international.notes: The official international page publishes a list of English-taught courses, but its linked list names Business School, Engineering School, and Bilingual Elementary School courses only; it says availability varies each semester. No current Medicina course taught in English was verified. Incoming contact: incoming@uandes.cl. Director of International Relations: Rosario Díaz.

profile_paragraphs: UANDES's Faculty of Medicine began teaching in 1991. It has five undergraduate programmes and reports more than 30 postgraduate and diploma programmes; its Medicina programme is accredited for six years through February 2028.
The faculty is in Las Condes, Santiago. Its dean is Enrique Oyarzún Ebensperger. Faculty contact is María Verónica Zamorano Hiriart, mvzamorano@uandes.cl, telephone 22 618 1610.

Its clinical training network lists Clínica Universidad de los Andes and several public and private hospital sites. Clínica UANDES has a Reumatología Adulto service with a listed multidisciplinary clinical team.

For a rheumatologist, there is a clinical rheumatology service and a Faculty of Medicine professor in that field, but UANDES's official accredited-specialty list does not include a rheumatology specialty programme. No academic faculty vacancy was listed on 3 September 2026.
